ios.desc:
Unscanny helps you find out where your photos appear online — and scan everyday data from images and text in one tap.

Face Search
Upload a photo of yourself (or someone who's given you explicit consent) and Unscanny searches public images across the web for matches. See how many results turn up, then view full details securely in your browser. Useful for checking if your photos are being used without your permission, verifying a match before a date, or spotting a catfish.

Your privacy matters: photos are used only to run your search, and results — along with your photo — are automatically deleted after 7 days.

Smart Scanner
Unscanny is also a versatile scanner that extracts and organizes data from images and text.
• Phone Numbers: Start a WhatsApp or Telegram chat, call, message, or copy instantly.
• Emails: Open your email app or copy the address with ease.
• IBANs: Quickly copy and store IBANs for future use.
• QR Codes: Extract QR code content for use in crypto apps and more.
• Searchable Scans: Search through text from your past scans.
• Camera & Text Scanning: Scan images directly from your camera or extract text from any image.
• Easy Copy & Paste: Seamlessly copy and paste scanned content for quick use.

Contact Us
We'd love to hear from you!
Email: unscanny.info@gmail.com

Download Unscanny today and take control of your photos and data!

---

Terms of Use: https://www.unscanny.com/en/terms

show_hn.title: Show HN: Unscanny – an app designed to turn screenshots into actions

quotes.text:
Ever had to manually type out a phone number from a screenshot? Or worse — switch between your photo gallery and WhatsApp just to write someone a message? That frustration led me to build something simple but powerful.

Meet Unscanny – an app designed to turn screenshots into actions.

It all started when I kept seeing local businesses post their phone numbers on Instagram stories. No clickable links, just plain numbers. I had to screenshot, open my phone app, and type the number manually. Even worse, some said “DM us on WhatsApp or Telegram” — again, no links, just text.

So I built Unscanny, an app that:
 Lets you share a screenshot directly from your gallery
 Detects phone numbers and emails in the image
 Gives instant actions like Call, Message on WhatsApp/Telegram, Send Email, or Copy

But I didn’t stop there.

Someone sends you their IBAN as an image? Unscanny detects it and lets you copy it instantly.
 Need to send crypto and they send their wallet address as a QR code screenshot? Unscanny scans it and gives you the address in one tap.

All the annoying bits — gone.

Available now:

App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/unscanny/id6739267314

Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.goktug.unscanny

Built from real pain points. If you've ever typed something you could've just tapped — Unscanny is for you.

Would love to hear your thoughts, feedback, or feature ideas!
